mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP3A4; triamcinolone may induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing tolterodine levels, while additive anticholinergic effects may occur with systemic corticosteroid use.
action: Monitor for reduced anticholinergic efficacy of tolterodine; consider dose adjustment if needed and counsel on additive anticholinergic adverse effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation).
